system.description:
7th Level Clan Feature

Your clans laid back life style bleeds into your procedure during missions. Once per rest, you and all of your allies can partake in a short lunch break. By spending 10 minutes sharing your secret stash, you and all allies that participated, regains 3d6 hit points. This increases to 4d6 at 11th and 5d6 at 15th level.
